finding: Fixed investment financing rose among Slovak firms, surpassing the euro area share
bullets: Fixed investment citations rose from 34.2% to 40.7% among Slovak firms (n=242), up 6.5 pp from the previous wave and above the EA's 38.4%.
Inventory and working capital remained the dominant financing purpose for Slovak firms at 57.0% (n=242), 16.2 pp above the EA's 40.8%.
Refinancing or paying off obligations declined from 21.5% to 17.0% among Slovak firms (n=241), converging toward the EA's 15.8%.
chart_subtitle: 57% of Slovak firms cited working capital financing.
